comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
This is apparently a MA reward for completing the "Proof of Mythology No.2" MA (which includes bowl of hygeia, Godly Bracelet and Kairos' Talisman, all drops from the ??? guardians in Atlantis dungeon).

It is apparently fairly difficult to get because Kairos' Talisman only drops from ??? guardians on f40+ and Godly Bracelet from f50+ (which don't spawn every time), and rare drops at that.

Per the Japanese wiki, stats are +2 swordplay/mastery? (not sure which), +1 trap +1 tactics. Attack/Def/Dura unknown. Anyone who's got one and could share stats, please enlighten us :)

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: I was browsing a japanese blog about this MA, and it seems the godly bracelet is a drop from the black aura guardians, of which can be found on hidden floors past section 60 i believe. I got the kairos talisman and am only missing the bracelet =(
